regime_context: Canada/TSX shows Oil & Gas Producers as the clear headline leader (score 1.655, durability 0.73, full breadth 1.0) with a narrowing eligible base (6/16) and non-directional rotation. Momentum rank is an attention lens only; the one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate, which is helping here. Six themes are trend-eligible; Gold Miners, Base Metals, and Utilities are all ineligible (below trend-gate), so the discipline is screening them out despite some positive ranks.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Pipelines & Midstream (trend tag, durability 0.74, breadth 0.75, eligible) can close the 1.59 score gap to Oil & Gas while breadth stays above 0.7 — that would suggest energy leadership broadening beyond producers; the watch retires if the gap widens or breadth falls below 0.5.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The only theme that combines top momentum rank, eligibility under the absolute-trend gate, full breadth (1.0), and solid durability (0.73). Crowding is present (z=1.3), but per guardrails this caps sizing rather than invites a fade — the leader is not to be faded on a crowding flag. Given track-record direction accuracy is only 0.316, conviction stays low despite clean leadership.
theses.dissent: Crowding plus full breadth can mark a top; the rank has no forward return edge and energy is highly sensitive to an unhedged macro headline (unscheduled_share=1.0), so the absolute trend could reverse quickly.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Second-highest rank and eligible, with a 'trend' hurst tag and non-crowded positioning (z=0.35). Breadth is moderate (0.429), confirming it is a genuine but not dominant challenger in the rotation. The trend gate is the validating leg; rank difference to oil (margin 1.02) is wide, so this is not a confirmed handoff, just a durable second leg.
theses.dissent: Breadth below 0.5 means leadership is narrow — a few large-cap banks may be driving the score, not a broad sector move, and direction accuracy is historically weak.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Despite ranking third, the trend gate marks this ineligible (eligible=false) and durability is near zero (0.16) with zero breadth — exactly the shake-out condition the one validated edge is built to screen. Avoid is the disciplined read, not a bearish forecast.
theses.dissent: Gold miners can move sharply on a single macro shock (geopolitics is a dominant narrative theme), so avoidance could miss a fast reflex rally.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes 5% above its 20-day high before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
